portal_hypertension.abstract: Patients with cirrhosis often develop autonomic dysfunction (AD) and endothelial dysfunction (ED), which correlate with higher mortality. Aerobic exercise (AE) is a potential intervention, yet its effects on the autonomic nervous system (ANS) and hemodynamics remain underinvestigated in cirrhosis. We conducted a parallel-group randomized controlled trial including 50 sedentary patients with compensated cirrhosis. Participants were randomized to a 16-week moderate-intensity AE plus nutritional consultation (AE group; n = 25) or nutritional consultation alone (control group, CG; n = 25).
